_provenance: Anchors are the Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe values adopted repo-wide in saltyBiomass (experiments/analysis/incubations/constants.py, BATCH_PALETTE). Do not invent values outside this file.
_concept_salt_family: Hue family encodes which salt the brine was made from. One hue per salt; intensity within a hue encodes concentration (dark = more salt, light = less).
_concept_source: Measured and modelled values are distinguished by mark, not hue: filled circles for the instrument, solid lines for the model. This keeps hue free to carry the salt condition, so a reader learns one colour key for the whole figure set.
_concept_annotation: Neutral greys for reference lines, thresholds and guides, so they never compete with data.
